name: PE-Core Tiny
description: Detects AI-generated images from CLIP-style features (Perception Encoder, 6M parameters, 12.5 MB). 94.6% balanced accuracy on DeepDetect-25 faces (92.0% after compression or blur); catches about 65% of fakes from the newest generators (GPT-Image-1.5, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 4.5, Imagen 4, FLUX.2).
